title: Test Script
description: Schema representing an automated test script used to verify API behavior, validate code, and ensure software quality.

id.description: Unique identifier for the test script.

name.description: Human-readable name of the test script.

description.description: Detailed description of what the test script validates.

type.description: Category of test the script performs.

framework.description: Testing framework used to execute the script (e.g., Postman, Karate, Playwright, k6).

language.description: Programming language the test script is written in.

target.description: The API or endpoint this script targets.

url.description: Base URL of the API under test.

method.description: HTTP method exercised by this script.

assertions.description: List of assertions the script checks.

description.description: Human-readable description of what is being asserted.

tags.description: Labels for categorizing and filtering test scripts.

environment.description: Environment the script is designed to run in.

platform.description: CI/CD platform (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

workflow.description: Workflow or pipeline name that runs this script.

created.description: Date the test script was created.

modified.description: Date the test script was last modified.
